1. (Currently amended) A system for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: a processor; and a memory, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud has an associated size that is proportional to the keyword's frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a selected keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud has an associated size that is proportional to the keyword's frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword in the top-level lexical cloud prior to generating the lower-level lexical cloud.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, on keywords selected from the top-level lexical cloud and at least one lower-level lexical cloud.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, comprising a storage device that comprises technical documents, patents, Web pages, word processing documents, spreadsheet documents, or any combinations thereof, wherein the storage device is in communication with the processor.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 4, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to access files stored on the storage device and to automatically generate the plurality of keywords from content of the files using keyword extraction techniques.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords displayed in the top-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a readability threshold.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords displayed in the lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a readability threshold.

8. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a size of each keyword in a lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on the frequency of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

9. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to select a subset of the plurality of keywords based, at least in part, on a frequency of occurrence of each keyword in the data structure.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate the top-level lexical cloud, a plurality of lower-level lexical clouds, or both dynamically in response to user interactions and data structure updates.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate a filtered list of items to display based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and keywords selected from one or more lexical clouds.

12. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on measurements from one or more sensors that detect physical characteristics of the items.

13. (Currently amended) A method for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: generating a data structure in a non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generating a top-level lexical cloud by selecting a subset of the plurality of keywords based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure; and generating a plurality of lower-level lexical clouds, wherein each lower-level lexical cloud is generated by: creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a particular one of the plurality of keywords selected from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud as a second subset of the plurality of keywords that remain in the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second subset is chosen by selecting keywords with the highest overall frequency of occurrence in the temporary data structure after elimination of any items not associated with the particular keyword.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising obtaining the plurality of keywords by: obtaining a list of words associated with an item; excluding common words from the list using a stop-word filter; stemming words to obtain the plurality of keywords; and storing each of the plurality of keywords in the data structure.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising displaying a filtered list of items selected from the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a selection of a first keyword from the top-level lexical cloud and a selection of a second keyword from a lower-level lexical cloud generated in response to the first keyword selection.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising generating at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on aesthetic descriptions or physical characteristics provided during examination of the items.

18. (Currently amended) A non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising code configured to direct a processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud by selecting a subset of the plurality of keywords based on highest frequency of occurrence, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with a selected keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, wherein each keyword in the lower-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure.

19. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud prior to generating and displaying a corresponding lower-level lexical cloud.

20. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display a filtered subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a first keyword selected from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected from a lower-level lexical cloud.
